rationale: Price touched $57.24 (day's low) but has since bounced back to $57.36–$57.61 range, which weakens near-term momentum without invalidating the thesis — the 9-EMA at $57.46 is still capping price and the stop at $57.72 has not been threatened. However, the bounce off the low, the bullish sentiment reading of 0.99, and the failure to extend below $57.24 suggest fading short-side pressure; position is essentially flat and confidence in follow-through to $56.50 is low, so the prudent move is to hold and let price resolve against the stop or break lower rather than act preemptively.
